test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bury the hatchet

options.text: To make secret preparations to attack

solution:
The correct answer is **To settle disputes.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** **The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom is** **To settle disputes.
 
• The idiom Bury the hatchet means To settle disputes.
 
 
• ​Example- He definitely doesn't promise to stop hoping that you'll **bury the hatchet **already.
 
 
 
• Thus the correct meaning would be To settle disputes.
